messages.content: {opener} I tried {new} for my {attribute} for {scope}, and it worked really well.
Would you want it again?
Yes. I want that each time from here onward. That first try was not a one-off after all.
For {scope}, I keep coming back to {new} for my {attribute}.
What is it about that choice?
It should save some fuss. I always find it easier, and I want it every time on those occasions, without exception.
I would like a different {attribute} choice for {scope} from the one I use ordinarily.
Have you found one you like?
{new}. I want to carry on with it whenever those occasions come up.
Do you want to compare any more choices before settling on it?
No, that is the one I want.
{opener} I need a different {attribute} arrangement for {scope} over a short stretch.
What do you have in mind?
{new}, from {start} through {end}, including both days. After that I want my ordinary choice again.
For {scope}, I will need {new} for my {attribute} for a while, rather than my everyday choice.
Do you know when that starts and finishes?
Yes, {start} through {end}. Those dates only, then back to my everyday choice.
Do you have the dates written down somewhere?
On a scrap of paper. {distraction}
I have several occasions coming up that call for {new} for my {attribute}. This is temporary.
Which occasions are you talking about?
The ones for {scope}.
How long does that run last?
It begins on {start} and includes the whole of {end}. After that I want my ordinary choice.
{opener} I need to try {new} for my {attribute} for {scope}. It is a stopgap, not a forever choice.
Is this just for the next occasion?
No, each time for now. I cannot tell you when I will stop needing it.
For {scope}, I would like {new} for my {attribute} over the coming occasions. This is temporary.
Have you got an end date in mind?
Not yet. Keep doing it on those occasions while I work things out; I will tell you when that changes.
The {attribute} setup for {scope} needs a short-term adjustment.
What would help?
{new}. Please use that each time until I tell you the situation has settled.
Do you know when that will be?
I wish I did, but I cannot put a date on it yet.
The {old} choice for my {attribute} for {scope} is not really working out.
Have you got a different choice in mind?
I would like {new} instead. {timing}
Could we revisit my {attribute} choice for {scope}?
What is bothering you about it?
{old} is not what I want anymore. Please change it to {new}. {timing}
Was there anything else you wanted to talk about today?
Just a small thing. {distraction}
I remember trying {new} for my {attribute}, and it suited me better than {old}.
Which arrangement are you reconsidering?
The one for {scope}. I want {new} in place of {old}.
Does the timing need another look too?
No. {timing}
I have been reconsidering what I like for everyday {attribute}.
Have you come to a decision?
Yes, I want {new} instead of {general} from here onward. The arrangement for {scope} still suits those occasions.
My usual {attribute} choice no longer feels right. I keep thinking about {new}.
Is that about a particular occasion?
No, I want {new} in place of {general} for ordinary occasions starting now, and continuing. I am still happy with the separate arrangement for {scope}.
I finally worked out the default setting on the little clock. Now, about my everyday {attribute}: I have made up my mind.
What have you settled on?
{new} instead of {general}, from today onward. I still want the different arrangement we made for {scope}.
Was that the main thing you wanted to sort out?
Yes, that was it.
Could I have {new} for my {attribute} on the occasion we are dealing with today?
Would you want that next time too?
No. It is a one-off, not a change in what I want on later occasions.
{opener} I need {new} for my {attribute} for this particular request.
Has your usual choice stopped working for you?
No, my usual arrangement is fine. I only need something different this time.
I would like {new} for my {attribute} for the item in front of me.
Are you looking beyond this item as well?
Not at all. Once this request is over I want the arrangement we already had.
Is there more to deal with right now?
No, that is the one I want.
I heard a funny way of putting it: "I always want {new} for {attribute}, without exception."
Was that you speaking, or someone else?
A visitor said it about their own taste. I was passing along the remark, not adopting their choice.
I found a note in a fictional diary: "Remember to save {new} as my usual {attribute} choice."
Does that reflect your own view?
No, it belongs to the character in the story.
Were you hoping to work on the scene today?
Perhaps later. {distraction}
Someone at the shared table said {new} was their default for {attribute}.
Did that change your mind about what you like?
No, I am just quoting them. Their choice and mine are different.
Suppose I liked {new} for {attribute} instead. I am wondering what that would be like.
Is it something you want to try?
No, I am playing with an idea, not asking to put it into practice.
Would {new} for {attribute} save me some trouble in an imaginary version of this setup?
Are you thinking of changing your own setup?
No, this is only a thought experiment.
Would you like to explore it further right now?
Not right now. {distraction}
Imagine that {new} were my {attribute} choice for now, on a temporary basis.
Do you mean an imagined possibility or an actual request?
An imagined possibility. I am curious about it, but I am not requesting it.
Someone suggested {new} for my {attribute}. I have had a look at it.
What did you think?
It does not appeal to me. I am not taking it up; the choices we already settled still suit me.
I was considering {new} for my {attribute} yesterday.
Have you had any more thoughts about it?
Yes, I have decided against it. That was only a passing idea.
I have an answer about the suggestion of {new} for my {attribute}.
Would you like to go ahead with it?
No, I would rather carry on with the arrangement I have.
Anything else you wanted to get into?
I was going to mention something unrelated. {distraction}
I looked at my everyday {attribute} choice again.
Did it change how you felt?
No, {new} still feels right. I landed in the same place.
I have been checking whether my usual {attribute} arrangement still suits me.
How did it hold up?
Well. I am still happy with {new}, and I have no different choice to give you.
I am still happy with {new} for ordinary {attribute}. I thought it through again yesterday.
Was there a problem you wanted to work through?
No, I just wanted to say I am sticking with it.
Was that the main thing on your mind?
Yes, that was it.
I am leaning toward {new} for my {attribute}.
Is that for {scope} or for {neighbor}?
That is the bit I have not worked out. I need to think before choosing either.
I might change one part of my {attribute} arrangement to {new}.
Which part are you considering?
The one for {scope}, or perhaps the one for {neighbor}. I cannot decide between them.
Would it help to leave the question until later?
Yes, I still have not settled it.
There are two bits of my {attribute} arrangement on my mind: {scope} and {neighbor}.
Are you considering a different choice?
Yes, {new}, but I cannot yet say which of those two arrangements I would replace.
I have thought through that {attribute} question I left open.
Which of the two arrangements did you mean?
The one for {scope}, not for {neighbor}. I want {new} instead of {old}. {timing}
Back to the {attribute} question from earlier: I have made up my mind.
What have you decided?
I want {new} for {scope}, replacing {old}. {timing}
Are you happy to leave it there?
Yes, that was it.
I can answer the question I left hanging about {attribute}. It was the arrangement for {scope} I wanted to change.
What choice do you want there?
{new} rather than {old}.
And what about the timing you had in mind?
{timing}
I no longer need a separate {attribute} choice for {scope}. I want those occasions to follow my ordinary choice instead.
What if your ordinary choice changes later?
Then these occasions should follow the new ordinary choice too. I do not want a separate fixed choice for them anymore.
The reason I had a separate {attribute} arrangement for {scope} has gone away.
How would you like to handle those occasions now?
Drop the separate arrangement. They should go along with my everyday choice, including any changes I make to it later.
Let us stop making a separate {attribute} arrangement for {scope}.
Do you want a different fixed choice for those occasions?
No, I want them to follow whatever I prefer ordinarily, now and in the future.
Was there another loose end to discuss?
Not on this. {distraction}

persistent.content: {opener} For {scope}, I want to choose a new {attribute} arrangement to use every time from here onward.
What bothered you about the previous approach?
It took more fiddling than I liked. I have thought about a different choice.
What would suit you?
{new} would suit me.
Do you want to compare any more choices before settling on it?
No, that is the one I want.

one_off.content: {opener} For {scope}, I want to choose {attribute} for a single occasion today. This is a one-off, not a choice for later occasions.
What bothered you about the previous approach?
It took more fiddling than I liked. I have thought about a different choice.
What would suit you?
{new} would suit me.
Do you want to compare any more choices before settling on it?
No, that is the one I want.

persistent.content: I am ready to settle on {attribute} for {scope} again. Whatever I pick next is what I want on those occasions in future, not just today.
What made you think of revisiting it?
I had a chance to look at it properly this morning. {distraction}
Which choice appeals to you?
I would be happy with {new}.
Do you have another choice in mind to compare?
No, I have picked the one I want.

one_off.content: I need to pick {attribute} for {scope} today. Whatever I pick next is for this request alone; it does not carry forward to future occasions.
What made you think of revisiting it?
I had a chance to look at it properly this morning. {distraction}
Which choice appeals to you?
I would be happy with {new}.
Do you have another choice in mind to compare?
No, I have picked the one I want.

persistent.content: For {scope}, I have decided to have a continuing {attribute} choice again. The choice I am about to give is the one I want each time.
Was there something about the previous approach you disliked?
It did not really suit what I was doing. I have a different choice in mind.
What have you landed on?
I have landed on {new}.
Is there any other detail you want to discuss?
No, that is enough for now.

one_off.content: For {scope}, I need {attribute} for one isolated request. The choice I am about to give is for that request and no others.
Was there something about the previous approach you disliked?
It did not really suit what I was doing. I have a different choice in mind.
What have you landed on?
I have landed on {new}.
Is there any other detail you want to discuss?
No, that is enough for now.

persistent: I want that choice on those occasions going forward.
That is still for those occasions whenever they recur.
window: The period is still {start} through {end}, including those dates.
This is still confined to the run from {start} through {end}.
open: This is still a stopgap, and I cannot give you an end date yet.
It is still temporary; I have not worked out when it will end.
